sentences.text: The children play in the park.
My father works in an office.
I live in a small apartment.
The city is beautiful at night.
I gave up smoking last year.
My brother came back from the army.
I think that you are right.
I hope that everything is fine.
When I was a child, I lived in a village.
I was tired, so I went to sleep.
I look up to my father.
Do you want to come with us?
I am not hungry at all.
I never drink coffee at night.
I am tired because I work every day.
We will get married next year.
I do not understand what you mean.
We go to the same school.
This is the best day of my life.
אני באמת אוהב את המקום הזה.
אני אף פעם לא שותה קפה בלילה.
אני עייף כי אני עובד כל יום.
אני תמיד שוכח את השם שלו.
אני לא מבין מה אתה רוצה.
זה היום הכי טוב בחיים שלי.
אני לא מכיר אף אחד כאן.
